English Proficiency Requirements
English Proficiency
All students applying to any of the mathematics graduate programs at UCCS, whose native language is not English, must demonstrate their English language proficiency through one of the following two means before being allowed to enroll in classes at the university.
Exemptions to English language proficiency demonstration requirements may be granted to some students. See the UCCS admissions page for more details.
